'''Krystick Moonskimmer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Benthar's Boys]] gang on [[Draenell's Point]]. He became [[Benthar]]'s lieutenant after [[Droxie]] defected to the [[Vibroblade gang]]. Moonskimmer later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] when Alliance operatives convinced both gangs to unit against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
